notes.title: Update 1.2.0 [Beta] - Steam Achievements
notes.content:
There is a new beta branch where you can test out upcomming features. To activate it go to your games library, rightclick on Platform Golf -> Propertys. In the tab BETAS select the beta branch to opt in. Be warned, maybe unstable!
    Fixed a bug where the "Gem Collector" achievement would not trigger
    Fixed a bug where the "Richie Rich" achievement  triggers to early
    Added Steam achievement  (they will unlock if you already had them)

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
Added the ability to restart a level by clicking the restart button in the top right corner, even if the level is finished. The player can now retry to get a better score.
    Added Info under release notes (settings) how the star system works. "5 hits left = 3 stars, 3 hits left = 2 stars, 1 hits left = 1 star"

notes.title: Update Version 1.1
notes.content:
Update Version 1.1 
-	Fixed a placement bug in level 7
-	Physics overhaul for general smother gameplay 
-	Fixed a bug where one could not click anywhere after finishing a level
-	Fixed a sound bug while the ball was rolling downhill
-	Changed Collision detection for ramps 
-	Smoothed collision polygons for all levels
-	Fixed some placement bugs 
-	First preparation for potential multiplayer version 
-	Fixed Steam Overlay not working
